# IKE Platform

> Consumer-facing parent POM, BOM, and workspace management plugin
> for the IKE Network. External doc and code projects inherit
> from ike-parent (declared here); cross-repo workspace operations
> use ike-workspace-maven-plugin (ws:* goals). Consumes ike-docs
> as an external artifact — ike-parent declares ike-doc-maven-plugin
> with extensions=true, resolving from Nexus at project-load time.
> Split from the archived ike-pipeline; see IKE-Network/ike-issues#216.
